facts.fact: Minister Djibril Ouattara said on 4 November 2026 that the Startup Act was adopted in November 2023.
On 4 November 2026 the government named 14 start-ups under Ivoire Tech Next 15 and 18 SMEs under Ivoire Tech Scale Up for 24 months of state support, as a step in implementing the Startup Act.
